goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

current_best.notes: Iteration 10 (kernel v19) kept context 512/win 128 and added modded-nanogpt ReLU^2 MLP + logit_softcap=15 on the final logits. Clean 40/40 TPU run (~42 min), val_bpc 2.2486 @ E36 — new best. Iter-9's ctx-1024 probe (mn2p267h, 2.5418) was undertrained, NOT a valid direction. Key signal: train/loss 1.288 vs val/loss 1.562 = 0.27 nats overfitting gap at 10M chars -> model is DATA-LIMITED. Progression: 2.5909 -> 2.3023 -> 2.2878 -> 2.2597 (ctx512) -> 2.2486 (relu2+softcap).

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. Treat these fields as opaque labels when reading this file in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-11 (in flight): scale data 10M -> 30M chars at the iter-10 best config (bs512/win128/d1024/relu2/softcap15/40ep). Rationale: 0.27-nat train/val gap at 10M = data-limited; 3x data attacks the overfitting gap directly. Expect ~2.5h runtime (3x steps/epoch) — well inside the 9h session cap. Target <2.2 BPC.
If 30M helps, push toward the full 100M enwik8 corpus (SOTA numbers are quoted at full-corpus) — watch the 9h session cap, may need to cut epochs or stride.
Re-enable the online W&B sweep over d_model/chunk_dec_layers/lr once the data-scaling experiment is green.
Add ModelCheckpoint every epoch + resume-on-restart so a TPU session timeout never loses progress (kernel reruns can resume from the last checkpoint).
Evaluate ALiBi for chunk-level attention (currently forced off in TF due to slow impl).
Add a true text8 evaluation path (alternative corpus to cross-validate generalization).
